sentences.text:
---- Respondent
For Petitioner : Dr. Sudeep Agrawal, Advocate For State : Mr. Praveen Das, Dy. Advocate General
and Mr. Vedant Shadangi, Panel Lawyer Hon'ble Shri Justice Parth Prateem Sahu Order On Board
10/07/2024
1.
Learned counsel for petitioner submits that in the land acquisition proceedings, the award has been passed on 28.04.2023 computing the amount of compensation to be awarded in favor of petitioner.

After getting the knowledge of computation of amount of compensation and considering to be on lower side, he has filed a reference under provision of Section 64 (1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred as "the Act of 2013") however, it could not be considered as the authority is not appointed by the State Government.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
He submits that quantum of amount of compensation awarded to petitioner is Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:24672 not under challenge to be on higher side and,
therefore, amount of compensation already computed and calculated is to be disbursed in favor of petitioner.

If petitioner succeed in reference proceedings, petitioner will be entitled for additional /
difference amount of compensation to be calculated by Authority.
Petitioner is in dire need of money.

Petitioner also submitted a representation before the Collector dated 14.05.2024 as also Daya Bai vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 10 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92296129/
1 before the Secretary i.e. respondent No.1, however, representation / application of petitioner for disbursement of amount of compensation is not considered and therefore, direction be issued to the concerned respondent to take decision on the claim of petitioner at the earliest.

entities.text: Daya Bai vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Considering facts and circumstances of the case, nature of grievance raised and particularly amount of compensation computed, calcuated and awarded in favor of petitioner has already been deposited and it has been further forwarded in terms of Section 77 the Act of 2013 to the Collector.

Respondent No. 1 and respondent No. 2 are directed to take decision on the pending representation/claim of petitioner at the earliest preferably within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of this order.

Sd/-
 (Parth Prateem Sahu)
